notes: Milestone-2 cases are solvable with the standardized symptom plus ONE current measurement: the symptom separates every condition except the two voltage-equivalent pairs (R1×2 vs C1×2 and R1×0.5 vs C1×0.5, identical output voltage), and either current instrument separates those. A perfect score shows that the evidence pipeline, the budget and the repair verification work end to end on these cases; it is not evidence of diagnostic skill and 100 % identification is not an achievement by itself.
Small sample (one frozen held-out set). No statistical comparison or superiority claim is made between runners.
Circuits are simulated with ngspice (ideal source, ideal R and C, no load, parasitics or component tolerances). Results are simulations, not physical measurements.
Latencies are wall-clock times on the machine that ran the evaluation, including the ngspice subprocesses; they are not a service-level benchmark.
